_comment: 2-group ensemble weights for the FINAL 6-model submission (Kaggle 2.954). Single architecture (all 6 are NBAv46Model). 'ball_weights' route entity 0 (the ball); 'player_weights' route entities 1-10 (pooled). Fit by constrained least-squares (w>=0, sum=1) on the honest 80% validation predictions, then applied to the 100%-data (_full) test predictions. Order matches 'pool'. These are the published fitted weights to 3 d.p.; the authoritative submitted artifact is solution.csv.

role.v46_s3: player generalist (seed 3; the only cross-over member)
